short.zh: 同一块电路板，换个顺序

t.zh: 在<level-ref to="stones"></level-ref>里，机器人按长度扫。换一个顺序，还能算对吗？
t.en: In <level-ref to="stones"></level-ref> the robot scanned by length. Would another order work too?

t.zh: 这一关有两个任务，用的是同一块电路板：任务 1 机器人按长度扫；任务 2 换成逐行，从下往上。两种顺序下都要算对。
t.en: This level has two tasks on the same circuit board: in task 1 the robot scans by length; in task 2 it switches to row by row, from the bottom up. Both orders have to come out right.

t.zh: <part-ref to="interval"></part-ref>已经在元件箱里，可以直接放上电路板。每一格要读它左边一整排、下面一整列：两种顺序都能让它们先算好吗？
t.en: The <part-ref to="interval"></part-ref> is already in your Parts, ready to go on the board. Each cell reads the whole row to its left and the whole column below it: do both orders get those computed first?

goal.zh: 合并石子，花费最少。同一块电路板，在两种扫描顺序下各通过一次。
goal.en: Merge the stones as cheaply as possible. Pass once under each of two scan orders, with the same circuit board.

how.zh: 任务 1 机器人按长度扫；任务 2 电路板留着，机器人换成逐行从下往上扫。
how.en: In task 1 the robot scans by length; in task 2 the board stays and the robot switches to row by row from the bottom up.

body.zh: 按长度、逐行从下往上、逐列每列从下往上，都行。它们只有一个共同点：每一格都排在它要读的格子之后。
body.en: By length, row by row from the bottom up, column by column from the bottom up: they all work. They have just one thing in common: every cell comes after the cells it reads.

body.zh: 顺序不是答案的一部分，只是「先算谁」的安排。
body.en: The order is not part of the answer, just an arrangement of “who goes first”.

note.zh: 只要被读的格子先算好，什么顺序都行。
note.en: Any order works, as long as the cells being read are computed first.

hints.zh: 放一块<part-ref to="interval"></part-ref>，把扫描臂的左段们、右段们和本格信息的这段总重，接到它的三个口上。
hints.en: Put down an <part-ref to="interval"></part-ref>, and wire the sweep arm’s left parts and right parts and This cell’s run weight to its three ports.

hints.zh: 每一格读的是同一行左边的格子，和同一列下面的格子：按长度扫，或者逐行从下往上扫，这些格子都已经先算好了。
hints.en: Each cell reads the cells to its left on the same row and the cells below it in the same column: scanning by length, or row by row from the bottom up, those cells have always been computed first.

ask.zh: 拼好电路板，按长度扫，让测试通过。
ask.en: Build the circuit board and pass the tests, scanning by length.

body.zh: 电路板会留着。机器人换成逐行从下往上扫，再跑一次。
body.en: The board stays. The robot switches to row by row from the bottom up; run it again.

hints.zh: 放一块<part-ref to="interval"></part-ref>，把扫描臂的左段们、右段们和本格信息的这段总重，接到它的三个口上。
hints.en: Put down an <part-ref to="interval"></part-ref>, and wire the sweep arm’s left parts and right parts and This cell’s run weight to its three ports.

hints.zh: 每一格读的是同一行左边的格子，和同一列下面的格子：按长度扫，或者逐行从下往上扫，这些格子都已经先算好了。
hints.en: Each cell reads the cells to its left on the same row and the cells below it in the same column: scanning by length, or row by row from the bottom up, those cells have always been computed first.

ask.zh: 电路板不变，机器人换成逐行从下往上扫。再通过一次。
ask.en: Same board; the robot now scans row by row from the bottom up. Pass again.
